# app/controllers/api/v1/products_controller.rb
class Api::V1::ProductsController < ApplicationController
  skip_before_action :verify_authenticity_token
  before_action :authenticate_api_key

  # GET /api/v1/products?category=electronics&sort=price
  def index
    category = params[:category]
    sort_col = params[:sort] || 'name'
    sort_dir = params[:direction] || 'ASC'
    min_price = params[:min_price]
    max_price = params[:max_price]

    # Build query with filters
    conditions = []
    conditions << "category = '#{category}'" if category.present?
    conditions << "price >= #{min_price}" if min_price.present?
    conditions << "price <= #{max_price}" if max_price.present?

    where_clause = conditions.any? ? "WHERE #{conditions.join(' AND ')}" : ''
    order_clause = "ORDER BY #{sort_col} #{sort_dir}"

    sql = "SELECT id, name, category, price, description, stock_count FROM products #{where_clause} #{order_clause} LIMIT 100"

    begin
      results = ActiveRecord::Base.connection.execute(sql)
      products = results.map do |row|
        {
          id: row['id'],
          name: row['name'],
          category: row['category'],
          price: row['price'].to_f,
          description: row['description'],
          stock_count: row['stock_count']
        }
      end

      render json: { products: products, count: products.length }, status: :ok
    rescue ActiveRecord::StatementInvalid => e
      Rails.logger.error("Query failed: #{e.message}")
      render json: { error: 'Query execution failed' }, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end

  # GET /api/v1/products/search?q=laptop
  def search
    query = params[:q]
    return render json: { error: 'Missing query parameter' }, status: :bad_request unless query.present?

    sql = "SELECT id, name, category, price, description FROM products WHERE name ILIKE '%#{query}%' OR description ILIKE '%#{query}%' ORDER BY name LIMIT 50"

    begin
      results = ActiveRecord::Base.connection.execute(sql)
      products = results.map do |row|
        {
          id: row['id'],
          name: row['name'],
          category: row['category'],
          price: row['price'].to_f,
          description: row['description']
        }
      end

      render json: { products: products, query: query }, status: :ok
    rescue ActiveRecord::StatementInvalid => e
      Rails.logger.error("Search failed: #{e.message}")
      render json: { error: 'Search execution failed' }, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end

  private

  def authenticate_api_key
    api_key = request.headers['X-API-Key']
    unless api_key.present? && ApiKey.exists?(key: api_key, active: true)
      render json: { error: 'Unauthorized' }, status: :unauthorized
    end
  end
end

The RDS parameter group has log_statement=all and pgaudit.log='write' for compliance monitoring. Environment variables: DB_USERNAME=storefront_api_ro, DB_PASSWORD=<secret>.
